also: it amounts to the same thing
it comes to the same thing
it’s all the same to me

evidence: Traupman p. 107: it’s all the same to me, meā nihil interest
Plaut. Pers. 537: meā quidem istuc nīl rēfert
terms.comment: To me, to you: nīl meā (tuā) interest or rēfert (Traupman 96).

phrases.latin: quod vērum an falsum sit, quoniam meā nihil interest, utrum mālim nesciō
phrases.english: whether it is true or false, since it makes no difference to me, I don’t know which I would prefer

phrases.latin: Meā quidem istuc nīl rēfert: tuā ego hoc faciō grātiā.
phrases.english: It makes no difference to me: I’m doing this for your sake.
it makes no difference: they are received with the same kindness
It amounts to the same thing.
